q: What are the emissions from shot blasting castings?
title: Shot blasting emissions per tonne
short: Shot blasting uses electricity for the blast wheels, dust collector and, in air blasting, a large compressor. Multiply the machine's kWh by 0.710 kg CO2 and divide by tonnes cleaned. Worn shot is bought steel, in Scope 3.

ul: kWh from a sub-meter on the blaster.

p: Run full loads, fix compressed air leaks on air blasters, and stop the dust collector between batches.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
